name: BossDB Contactome
summary: Computes a contactome (contact-area graph between touching segmented objects) from a BossDB precomputed segmentation with Cloudome, writing a SQLite database.
description: Resolves a BossDB segmentation channel to its precomputed CloudVolume location, splits it into cuboid tasks, runs Cloudome workers locally and sums per-cuboid contacts into contactome.db (table contactome_edges: graph_id, location, pre, post, weight in square nanometres). Use it to build a contact graph between neighbouring objects in an EM segmentation. The input must be a segmentation where objects touch; the output directory and databases must not already exist.

inputs.description: BossDB segmentation channel reference of the form bossdb://collection/experiment/channel.
inputs.requirements: Public channel stored as precomputed CloudVolume data, containing a segmentation whose objects touch.

outputs.description: SQLite database contactome.db (table contactome_edges with graph_id, location, pre, post, weight in square nanometres) and a contactome.log.

parameters.description: Directory in which output will be written
When storing more than one contactome in the same DB, this parameter differentiates them
The resolution of the segmentation at which the contactome should be calculated
Computations are calculated blockwise; this parameter specifies how large blocks should be. Scale this based on the memory capacity of the target machine
Subset the computation so that it starts at a specific z slice
Subset the computation so that it ends at a specific z slice
For testing, truncate the queue so that only this many blocks are computed
Number of local Cloudome worker processes that drain the task queue.

failure_modes.fix: Use a new, empty output directory.
